chapter.title: Partitions
chapter.para: A partition is the unit of isolation: it has its own memory, its own time windows and its own operating mode. This chapter states how partitions are loaded, started, restarted and stopped. The operating modes follow ARINC 653 and are written COLD_START and WARM_START for the initialization modes (INIT_COLD and INIT_WARM in the code).

section.title: SRQ_JET_PART_001
section.para: JetOS shall give each partition an operating mode, one of IDLE, COLD_START, WARM_START and NORMAL, and shall start each partition in COLD_START mode when the module starts.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: The mode tells what the partition may do and what the kernel does with its time.

formalpara.title: Verification
formalpara.para: Test.

section.title: SRQ_JET_PART_002
section.para: JetOS shall load the image of a partition from the archive embedded in the kernel into its memory space when the partition starts: it shall check the image and its loadable segments against the memory space of the partition, copy the segments, clear the memory that they do not initialize, and take the entry point from the image.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: The code of the partition is part of the kernel image; it must be put in the right place, and a damaged or oversized image must not corrupt anything.

formalpara.title: Verification
formalpara.para: Test.

section.title: SRQ_JET_PART_003
section.para: JetOS shall treat an image that cannot be loaded as a partition load error of the partition (see health monitoring).

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: A module must come up, or fail visibly, with a bad image in one partition.

formalpara.title: Verification
formalpara.para: Test.

section.title: SRQ_JET_PART_004
section.para: JetOS shall, when a partition starts or restarts, give it empty state: the memory of its image as loaded, no processes created, no ports created, the shared area initialized, all its stacks free; and shall run its first process, the main process, at the entry point of the image, with preemption locked.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: Each start is a fresh one, so that a restart really recovers the partition.

formalpara.title: Verification
formalpara.para: Test.

section.title: SRQ_JET_PART_005
section.para: JetOS shall change the mode of the calling partition at its request as follows: to COLD_START or WARM_START it shall restart the partition in that mode; to IDLE it shall stop its processing; to NORMAL it shall start its processes. The request shall be refused with an error for WARM_START while the mode is COLD_START, for NORMAL while the mode is NORMAL, and for any other mode.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: These are the mode transitions that ARINC 653 allows to a partition.

formalpara.title: Verification
formalpara.para: Test.

section.title: SRQ_JET_PART_006
section.para: JetOS shall, when a partition enters NORMAL mode, release its locked preemption and start the processes that were started during the initialization: an aperiodic process after its delay, a periodic process at the next start of periodic processing of the partition plus its delay, each with its deadline set.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: The initialization ends and the application runs at a defined time.

formalpara.title: Verification
formalpara.para: Test.

section.title: SRQ_JET_PART_007
section.para: JetOS shall, while a partition is in IDLE mode, run none of its processes, while its time slots stay assigned to it.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: An idle partition must not disturb the schedule of the others.

formalpara.title: Verification
formalpara.para: Test.

section.title: SRQ_JET_PART_008
section.para: JetOS shall record, for each partition, why it started last (normal start, partition restart, restart by the health monitor of the module or of the partition) and give it, with its identifier, period, duration, mode and lock level, as the status of the partition on request.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: An application decides what to recover from the reason of its start.

formalpara.title: Verification
formalpara.para: Test.

section.title: SRQ_JET_PART_009
section.para: JetOS shall let a partition raise the lock level of its preemption (locking it) up to a maximum of 16 levels (a request beyond it is refused with an error), and lower it; while the level is above 0 the current process shall not be preempted by another process of its partition, and when it falls to 0 the partition shall choose the process to run again. The level shall not change outside NORMAL mode or in the error handler.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: Preemption locking is the ARINC 653 means to protect short critical regions of a partition.

formalpara.title: Verification
formalpara.para: Test.

section.title: SRQ_JET_PART_010
section.para: JetOS shall run, if configured, kernel-only partitions without a memory space of their own, for the monitor and for the debugger, as part of the kernel.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: These partitions are parts of the kernel's own diagnostics, not applications.

formalpara.title: Verification
formalpara.para: Review.
